_comment: How the text functions render a value, as both evaluators must. Every file
in this directory is read by pkg/infra/evaluator/function_fixture_test.go
callFunction); each case is a whole expression evaluated against `source`.
A value is written the way the sample panel and a condition show it: a
number as its digits -- Go's %v spells 1704207845 as 1.704207845e+09 from a
million up -- an object or a list as JSON rather than map[a:1] or [a b],
and a missing field as empty text rather than <nil>. So a missing field
equals '', as it does in a condition.

cases.name: concat: a number of a million or more is its digits
concat: a small number
concat: a decimal keeps its point
concat: zero is 0, not empty
concat: false is false
concat: an object is its JSON
concat: a list is its JSON
concat: a missing field adds nothing
tostring: a number of a million or more is its digits
tostring: a decimal keeps its point
tostring: a missing field is empty
lower: a missing field is empty, not <nil>
upper: false is FALSE
trim: zero is 0, not empty
replace: in a number's digits
substring: of a number's digits
contains: in a number's digits
contains: a missing field contains nothing
eq: a number equals its digits
eq: a missing field equals empty text, as in a condition
eq: an object compares as its JSON
